messages:
sara_cs: Quick weekly pulse for LUMENO — account health check. Summary: usage steady, spend +5% MoM, but error rate jumped from 0.9% to 4.3%. Biggest contributors: 5xx (502/503), timeouts (504), and spikes in 429s during peak batch jobs. Top failing endpoints below.

jess_onboard: Thanks — are these happening across Hosted and Dedicated or only their Dedicated cluster? :eyes:

sara_cs: Looks concentrated on their Dedicated pool in us-west-2. Hosted traffic unaffected. We see error bursts aligned with their nightly batch at ~02:00 PT.

mike_prod: Not aware of infra changes on our side. Did ops roll any kernel/driver updates last week?

ivan_eng: No kernel updates on Redwood's side for that cluster. I pulled the request traces — lots of prefix-KV cache misses and long tail on sequence length. Suspect large batched requests hitting memory regen path.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy to lumi-dedicated-usw2 completed 2024-05-02 01:40 UTC. No rollbacks.

jess_onboard: LUMENO confirmed they bumped batch_size in SDK from 16 -> 64 two days ago. They said it reduced latency locally but maybe overloads their Dedicated pool.

sara_cs: Here's the quick endpoint breakdown (5 most-failing):
```
1) POST /v1/generate -> 502 (47%), 504 (23%), 429 (5%)
2) POST /v1/chat/stream -> 504 (31%), 502 (26%), client timeouts (18%)
3) POST /v1/embeddings -> 502 (40%), rate-limit (429) during spikes
4) POST /v1/rewrite -> 504 (50%) but lower traffic
5) GET /v1/health -> intermittent 500s during spikes (10% of cluster errors)
```

mike_prod: Do we have P95/P99 latency shifts to correlate?

sara_cs: P95 gen up from 180ms -> 650ms during batch window. P99 spikes to 3.2s. Error rate curve attached (screenshot shared in channel).

ivan_eng: Can you paste one failing log snippet? Want to check kernel queues.

sara_cs: Log sample from their request_id=lum-req-9f2a:
```
2024-05-02T02:03:12Z WARN runtime: request queued, wait=412ms, kv-cache-miss=true
2024-05-02T02:03:14Z ERROR model: generation failed, upstream=502, message="kernel OOM? retryable"
2024-05-02T02:03:14Z DEBUG trace: sequence_len=8192, batch_size=64, worker=3
```
jess_onboard: Actionable items I propose: 1) Ask LUMENO to revert to batch_size=16 for now, 2) Schedule a joint triage call with Eng (Ivan) + their SRE, 3) Put canary fallback to smaller model variant during nightly window.

ivan_eng: Agreed. Also we can enable temporary per-customer request queue limit on their Dedicated pool and bump autoscale thresholds for 02:00-03:00 PT. Quick mitigation should reduce 5xxs.

mike_prod: I'll prepare a rollback playbook for SDK change and a suggested client-side retry/backoff snippet they can drop in.

sara_cs: I'll open an account ticket and recommend the batch_size rollback + include our suggested retry snippet. Also flag renewal risk — if errors continue we should schedule an enablement session and offer a Dedicated autoscale credit for the next 2 weeks.

jess_onboard: Can someone own the triage call scheduling? I can coordinate with LUMENO calendar if someone owns the eng side.

ivan_eng: I'll take the eng side. Available slots tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PT.

sara_cs: Awesome. TL;DR action items: [sara_cs] open ticket + mitigation suggestions, [mike_prod] rollback playbook & retry snippet, [ivan_eng] enable queue limit + join triage. We'll follow up after the call and re-check error curve. :thumbsup:
